title: Teller refuses on camera to discuss Lazar

tellings.quote: I mean, I spoke to the guy before he went and interviewed Teller. He was one of Teller's students.

plain: In 1989 the famous physicist Edward Teller, a father of the hydrogen bomb, is said to have refused on camera to talk about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Lazar himself tells it, saying he spoke beforehand to the man who went to interview Teller, who had been one of Teller's students. Lazar raises it because Teller's silence would suggest he knew who Lazar was.
